text: A category consists of objects and morphisms with a composition operation. Which equations must composition satisfy?
choices: The unit laws (id_B∘f = f = f∘id_A) and associativity (h∘(g∘f) = (h∘g)∘f)
Every morphism has a two-sided inverse
Hom(A,B) is nonempty for all objects A, B
explanation: The category axioms are exactly the unit laws and associativity of composition; nothing else is assumed. Composition need not be commutative (it is usually not even defined in both orders), morphisms need not be invertible (those are isomorphisms), and Hom-sets may be empty.
